title: Kranti
desc: Sanga, a devout employee of Raja Laxman Singh, is falsely accused of killing him. He escapes prison and forms a group of revolutionaries with the sole aim of driving the British out of India.

title: Naag Bhoomi
desc: A dangerous criminal who traffics women terrorises a village community that ceremoniously worships a serpentine deity. Soon, an archaeologist gets caught up in the ensuing chaos.

title: Prem Rog
desc: After a series of tragedies shake Manorama's life, Devdhar, her childhood friend who falls for her, vows to make her happy. In the process, he faces the wrath of Manorama's conservative family.

title: Badal
desc: Badal's family dies at the hands of a corrupt police officer. While he is raised by his father's friend, he turns into a terrorist and vows to avenge his family's death.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
desc: Star-crossed lovers connect, only to be torn apart by familial obligations. They part ways reluctantly, clinging to the dream of a future reunion.
